en.headline: Helper minimum wage set at HK$5,220 for new contracts
en.dek: The government guide says the rate applies to contracts signed from 3 October. The food allowance stays at HK$1,236.
body: The government's foreign domestic helper guide now states that the minimum allowable wage is HK$5,220 a month, and that this level applies to all contracts signed on or after 3 October. The food allowance in lieu of free meals remains at not less than HK$1,236 a month.
Reports on Friday said the government had announced a rise from the previous monthly rate of HK$5,100, an increase of HK$120. The September 2025 review had set that earlier rate at HK$5,100.

Employers must still provide suitable accommodation with reasonable privacy, and either free food or the food allowance, under the standard employment contract. Existing contracts are not rewritten by the new rate until they are renewed.

zh.headline: 外傭規定最低工資調至5220元 明日起新約適用
zh.dek: 政府指引列明，每月5220元適用於10月3日或以後簽訂的合約，膳食津貼維持不少於1236元。
body: 政府外傭就業指引現列明，外籍家庭傭工的規定最低工資為每月5220元，適用於2026年10月3日或以後簽訂的所有合約。代替免費膳食的膳食津貼維持每月不少於1236元。
周五報道指，政府宣布規定最低工資由每月5100元上調120元。2025年9月的檢討曾把當時水平定為每月5100元。
按標準僱傭合約，僱主仍須提供合適並有合理私隱的住宿，以及免費膳食或膳食津貼。已生效合約的工資不會因新水平自動改寫，須待續約才按當時規定處理。
